justification: Three correctness fixes the user caught against the live brief. (1) NEARBY DAs showed 0 while the original PlotDetect map-viewer shows ~112: the brief called the flaky live ePlanning OnlineDA API with a tight 200m radius AND an exact council_name='X' filter (returns 0 on any name-format mismatch; the original deliberately uses a fuzzy ilike). Switched the brief to the consolidated development_applications table via the existing conveyancing_db.fetch_nearby_das (same reliable source the map-viewer uses), dropped the brittle council filter for this proximity query (the lat/lng bbox already constrains location), and widened the radius 200->500m. (2) PRE-DA showed 'Not run' even with the 'Include site history' box ticked: it was collected with timeout_satellite+5 = 50s, but the pre-DA pipeline takes 30-90s, so it always timed out. Added a dedicated timeout_premium=120s. Made the empty-state reason distinguish 'not requested' from 'ran but didn't finish' so the UI no longer tells a user who ticked the box to tick it again. (3) Per the user's 'reliability over speed' directive, raised terrain 55->80s (SIX Maps DEM is slow/variable) and shadow 30->50s so they finish reliably.

pre_impl.existing_data: conveyancing_db.fetch_nearby_das(conn, lat, lng, council_name, radius_m, days) already queries development_applications via a lat/lng bbox + Haversine and returns the same shape as the live get_nearby_das, but was unused by the brief. The brief has _get_db_conn() and already imports from conveyancing_db.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the live ePlanning API was the right DA source; the original app proves the consolidated development_applications table is the reliable one, and an exact council_name match silently zeroed results.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused the existing DB function and conn pattern; no new query written. Added a CONFIG.timeout_premium / timeout_shadow_collect and bumped timeout_terrain.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A DB connection failure propagates so nearby DAs report NOT_AVAILABLE (honest), not a false 0. The live ePlanning API (now unused by the brief) is no longer a failure source here.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend + a frontend empty-state message change. tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'No nearby DAs' on a street with 112 council DAs; 'Pre-DA Not run — tick the box' when the box was already ticked. After: nearby DAs come from the reliable table within 500m; pre-DA has 120s to complete and, if it still fails, says it couldn't finish rather than blaming the tickbox.

functions.name: _fetch_nearby_das
functions.input: lat, lng, council_name (unused as a filter), radius_m, days
functions.output: nearby DAs from the development_applications table via a bbox + Haversine proximity query, council filter intentionally dropped
functions.if_none: a connection failure propagates to NOT_AVAILABLE; a genuine empty result is an honest 0

functions.name: _build_neighbourhood pre-DA reason path
functions.input: whether pre-DA was requested and whether it produced a detail
functions.output: reason 'Site history not requested' when not requested, else the run's failure reason when it ran but produced nothing
functions.if_none: the frontend renders 'tick the box' only for not-requested, otherwise 'couldn't complete'

values: N/A - DA records and timeouts, not regulatory values.

queries.purpose: Fetch nearby development applications within a radius of the lot for the brief Neighbourhood section
queries.file_line: scripts/conveyancing_db.py fetch_nearby_das (reused, unchanged) — wired in services/intelligence_brief.py _fetch_nearby_das
queries.where_clause: latitude BETWEEN %s AND %s AND longitude BETWEEN %s AND %s AND (lodgement_date >= %s OR determination_date >= %s); council filter intentionally dropped for this proximity query; bounded by the connection 5s statement_timeout; SELECT only, no writes

break_it.scenario: The development_applications table is stale or missing coordinates for an area
break_it.what_happens: nearby DAs would under-report or read 0
break_it.repro: query a region with rows lacking latitude/longitude
break_it.how: rows with null lat/lng are skipped; the same table backs the original map-viewer which shows current data; a genuine 0 is honest and a connection failure surfaces NOT_AVAILABLE

break_it.scenario: Dropping the council filter pulls DAs from an adjacent council across a boundary
break_it.what_happens: a DA just over the LGA line could appear
break_it.repro: a property near a council boundary
break_it.how: the 500m radius is a proximity scope, not a jurisdiction claim — a DA 400m away is genuinely 'nearby' regardless of which council assessed it; results are sorted by distance

break_it.scenario: Pre-DA still exceeds 120s for some address
break_it.what_happens: it times out and shows 'couldn't complete'
break_it.repro: an address whose pre-DA pipeline runs >120s
break_it.how: 120s covers the documented 30-90s range with margin; on timeout the honest 'ran but didn't finish' message shows, not a false 'not run'

break_it.scenario: Longer terrain/pre-DA budgets make the whole brief slower under concurrency
break_it.what_happens: a brief could take ~2min and hold memory longer
break_it.repro: run a brief with site history + satellite on
break_it.how: the concurrency cap (#577) serialises briefs; the user explicitly accepts longer briefs for reliability; layers still run concurrently so total ~= the slowest layer

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - same /stream endpoint; the live ePlanning get_nearby_das remains for the conveyancing CLI only.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief for an inner-Sydney street with known DA activity: nearby DAs now list real applications within 500m. Tick 'Include site history' and run: pre-DA completes (up to 120s) instead of showing 'Not run'.
